description: Search Nomos Engineering Handbook chapters, Empirical Field Dispatches, Open-Core Architecture Specs, and CLI reference by keyword. Example: query='worktree isolation', section='handbook' finds chapters on Git worktrees. Use when looking up conceptual architecture, empirical benchmarks, or CLI flags. Do NOT use when inspecting a specific G-* gate or ERR_* code (use inspect_dod_gates or diagnose_nomos_error instead) or comparing external tools (use compare_governance_approaches instead).

query.description: Keywords or engineering problem phrase to search across the public Nomos corpus.

name: search_nomos_corpus

canonicalUrl.description: Canonical documentation or twin URL for citation.

matchCount.description: Number of top corpus matches returned.

title: Search Nomos Docs, Dispatches & Specs
